name: Evidence challenge

title: "Evidence challenge: "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Claim being challenged

Quote or link the exact Human Scale claim.

## Current evidence grade, if known

Strong / Moderate / Working hypothesis / Value judgment / Political proposal / Unsure

## Challenge

What is wrong, overstated, missing, outdated, confounded, or too broad?

## Best evidence

Prefer primary research, official data/guidance, systematic reviews, strong quasi-experiments, or direct implementation data. Include enough information for someone else to verify it.

## What the evidence actually supports

State the narrowest defensible conclusion.

## Contrary evidence or uncertainty

What would someone on the other side reasonably point out?

## Recommended change

Strengthen / Narrow / Split claim / Regrade / Remove / No change

## What would change your mind?

What evidence would make you withdraw or revise this challenge?
